svg.text: Modern direction: quiet player field, no headshot box, border-led parallels. Chrome, ice, and black finite use full-card material; checker/wave/mojo keep the effect mostly on the border shell.

g.text: quiet stock, clean border, headshot-forward base card
neutral field with refractor color concentrated in the rails
cool blue/cyan prism spectrum on the border shell
wavy violet/indigo refractor contained to the frame
warm gold/orange wave spectrum without changing the photo field
interlocking mojo lens/circuit geometry on rails and lower frame
controlled teal-violet-amber checker spectrum, edge-led only
whole-card chromium sheen with broad refractor hits
ice-crystal material masked away from the headshot zone
black finite chase-card material with gold/chrome trim

SVG shell + masks for border-only treatments, full-card material modules for chrome/ice/black, headshot cutout layer, typography plates, stat rails, CSS/SVG gradients, patterns, turbulence, and specular lighting.
